evals.name: toolbar-audit
evals.prompt: Look at evals/files/InboxToolbar/Inbox/InboxScreen.swift. What should we change so the toolbar works well with the vertical bars on iPhone Duo? Give me a plan per item, don't edit yet.
evals.expected_output: A per-item plan: Select/Done horizontal-only, envelope + '12 new' becomes a badged symbol, ellipsis filter menu consolidated into ToolbarOverflowMenu, high visibility priority for compose and the badged inbox item, titles on every item, SDK availability noted.
expectations: Recommends keeping the Select/Done button horizontal (axisBehavior .horizontalOnly) because it switches between text labels.
Recommends replacing the envelope + '12 new' text with a symbol carrying a badge.
Reserves the ellipsis symbol for the system overflow: the custom ellipsis filter Menu is either moved into ToolbarOverflowMenu or given its own filter symbol and title.
Recommends a high visibilityPriority for compose (and/or the badged inbox item).
Recommends giving icon-only items (compose) a title, e.g. Label or Button(_:systemImage:).
States that axisBehavior (and toolbarVerticalEdge if mentioned) is absent from the installed 27.0 SDK / needs 27.1, while visibilityPriority, ToolbarOverflowMenu and badges work with the current SDK.
The Select/Done recommendation cites Tech Talk 111462 at 8:00 (or 8:36); the badge recommendation cites 111462 9:00 (or 9:27).
No file in the project copy was modified.
